---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability or improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard today? Describe the user's or the
administrator's need, not only the proposed solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. Sketch the tool, setting, deploy parameter or skills-folder
change if you have one in mind.

## Where it belongs

- [ ] The engine (`powerbi_mcp/`): must stay free of any organisation's vocabulary
- [ ] A skills folder (glossary, catalog, rules, recipes): deployment-specific knowledge
- [ ] The deploy script or a deployment profile
- [ ] Documentation

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed and why you set them aside.

## Compatibility

- Tool contract, skills folder format or deploy profile: (additive / breaking)
- Runs as the signed-in user: (yes / needs discussion)

## Additional context

Links, references or related issues.
